annotations.title: Search course sessions near a place

description: Upcoming sessions of one course across the venues closest to a postcode or suburb, merged soonest first, with each venue's distance in km. near is required: this server can't tell where the person is, so ask them for their postcode or suburb. If a suburb exists in several states the reply lists the candidates: ask which one and retry with the state or postcode.

course.description: The course's id, unit code, workshops course id or name, as getCourseDetails accepts.

date_from.description: The first date to search, YYYY-MM-DD in Australia/Brisbane time. Defaults to today; a past date means today.

date_to.description: The last date to search, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 60 days after date_from and is capped at 365 days after it.

limit.description: How many sessions to return. Larger values are capped at 50; values below 1 use the default.

near.description: The person's Australian postcode or suburb, optionally with its state, such as 4510 or Caboolture QLD. Required: ask the person for it.

venues.description: How many of the closest venues to search. Larger values are capped at 5; values below 1 use the default.

name: search_nearby_sessions

sessions.description: The sessions, soonest first; null when there are none.

booking_page.description: The site's course finder, preselected for this course and venue. The person books there and pays on the enrolment site.

date_display.description: The date as the site shows it, such as Tuesday 20 October.

price_aud.description: The price in Australian dollars, GST included. A special price replaces the standard one.

price_display.description: The price as the site shows it.

seats.description: The seats left as the site shows them, such as 5+. Never the exact vacancy count.

time.description: The start and finish time as the site shows it.

distance_km.description: The distance from near in kilometres, to one decimal place. Present only on distance-ordered results.

id.description: The venue's id. The session endpoints accept it as location.

state.description: The state or territory, such as QLD.
